hypothesis: A decline in US active oil-directed drilling rigs over13 releases signals a future supply restraint and supports Brent; an increase signals future supply expansion and weighs on Brent. Slow production adjustment may leave a tradable delayed response. This is an unproved inference; rigs may merely lag already-priced oil demand and prices.
relationship: New Baker Hughes physical upstream investment information, not EIA V17 current inventories/refinery/demand, CFTC positioning, a price threshold retune or an old risk governor. No market price enters the source state.

source.selection: Country exactly UNITED STATES, DrillFor exactly Oil; sum all recorded county/basin/location/trajectory subgroups, no geography selection. Keep one source date per US_PublishDate. Missing count/date or unknown schema fails closed. Any duplicate subgroup identity masks the ENTIRE weekly oil/total count as unknown; retain date and raw rows, never deduplicate or use the ambiguous sum.
source.reconciliation: All weekly dates have US total and US oil data. Last date and aggregate US total/oil reconcile to NAM Summary D4,D11,D22 and labels B11,B22. This is a publisher tie-out, not proof of all original historical versions.
source.optional_metadata: County is allowed unknown and retained as such, never filled. Country/DrillFor/date/count/year/month and other grouping fields remain mandatory. Missing optional County is not missing rig count or justification to discard the row.
source.availability_assumption: End of US_PublishDate in America/Chicago, then daily MOEX EOD decision and strictly later factual active open. Publication-date field and official weekly schedule support a conditional development proxy, NOT original historical byte/receipt proof.
source.late_archive_policy: Archive is frozen at2025-08-29; absent later weeks stay missing/stale. Do not truncate the2025 evaluation calendar, backfill2026 data, or extend the final rig state beyond14calendar days at fill.
source.rights: Baker Hughes Rig Count FAQ grants public use subject to site terms with source attribution. Personal conditional research; original workbook remains outside Git, no redistribution or commercial/live-data entitlement claimed.

signal.primary: -sign(oil_rigs[t]-oil_rigs[t-13]); zero change is flat. Require all14 endpoint/intermediate counts known and all13 intervening publication gaps within5..9days, otherwise masked until a complete regular window has accumulated. No imputation, deduplication or shorter-history substitution.
signal.control: Constant long BR whenever the same source/history/freshness/active-map gates hold; control never promoted post outcome.
signal.schedule: Daily EOD allocation from most recent available weekly source state; no same-day open, no future calendar/volume ranking, daily active-map admission and causal roll inherited unchanged from V72 adapter.
signal.fit: none; no normalization, parameter search, volatility targeting or neural model

execution.terminal: Flat on final pre2026 factual active date. Missing opens cancel attempts; halts and carried positions remain explicit; no hidden GTC retry.
execution.input_scope: Pinned V64 recent catalog2018-2025; build exact full matching observation/spec join, then filter BOTH to BR and period. No new execution engine or source alteration.

screen_gates.coverage_denominator: All BR factual effective dates2018-2025 with source/history available and source fresh at fill, irrespective of eventual profitability; includes late2025 missing-source dates.
screen_gates.pass_means: STAGE2_CANDIDATE component only, conditional on late-vintage assumption; original-source availability, stability, independent evidence and full execution remain necessary. Goal20-50 percent is unchanged.

validation.scheme: Already-open2018-2025 development. One fixed hypothesis plus constant-long control; no fit or selected era. Source history2013-2017 is rig-count-only warmup. All8calendar years retained.

limitations: The workbook was published as a2025 archive and retrieved in2026. US_PublishDate labels and weekly publication convention do not prove original historical values, all revisions, or original receipt times. Historical results are conditional development evidence, never a causal or independent validation claim.

Rig count is not oil output: drilling efficiency, drilled-uncompleted wells, field decline, OPEC supply, global demand and endogenous reactions to oil prices can dominate. Oil count changes are not measured analyst-consensus surprises.

Daily opens, sizing/spec proxies, fees and margin are not proof of executable contemporaneous BID/OFFER, actual broker tariffs or available size. A1x requested allocation does not guarantee1x marked exposure at every close.
Late2025 has no new observations in this archive. Stale-source flat targets are retained in the full calendar. Missing source is not observed zero rig activity.

Repeated hypothesis searches on opened development data and narrow BR exposure cannot verify predictable20-50 percent annual profit. No demo activation, real orders, new collector or paper restart is authorized by this screen.
